 Sassuolo host Fiorentina in the penultimate match of the 10th round of Serie A 2026/2027. At the Mapei Stadium, where kick-off is at 6.30pm, Alberto Aquilani's side will look to bounce back from their heavy 6-2 defeat to Lazio in the midweek round. They face Vincenzo Vanoli's Fiorentina, who are also languishing in the league after a 2-2 draw with Atalanta left them firmly in the relegation zone.
 Sassuolo-Fiorentina 1-1
 Goalscorers: 25' Laurienté (S), 45+2' Pellegrino (F)
 Goals and highlights
 45+2' Goal - After 20 minutes of stalemate, the final attack of the first half brings the match to life. Following a scramble in the box, Njie recovers a difficult ball on the left, works space for a cross and sends it into the middle. Pellegrino uses his body to turn away from Candé, adjusts quickly and beats Turati into the bottom corner.
 25' Goal - Viery's costly loss of possession allows Esposito to win the ball and immediately play it forward to Laurienté. He sprints along the offside line to go one-on-one with De Gea, who isn't particularly quick off his line, then sends a low right-footed shot through the goalkeeper's legs to put Sassuolo ahead.
 5' Chance - Jimenez plays the ball forward for the run of Mastantuono who, one-on-one with Turati, pulls his angled shot too far across goal and narrowly misses the target.
 0' Kick-off at the Mapei Stadium in Reggio Emilia at 18:30.
